errors.quote: essentially all observed variance is technical
errors.issue: Clonal steady-state cells retain biological transcriptional bursting, cell-cycle and protein-turnover variation. Their joint dispersion is not pure technical noise and cannot identify the claimed biological fraction in primary PBMCs.

errors.quote: same donor, same tissue, different library preparations
errors.issue: These are technical replicates, not independent biological replicates. The later donor definition is correct, but claims must separate repeated preparation from donor generalization.

Split destructive libraries contain different cells, and barcode matches do not identify the same cells. The later population-level caveat is correct, but an embedding position is not interchangeable with cell identity for the proposed Jaccard statistic.

errors.quote: Remove markers with <20 % detection rate in the spike-in cells
errors.issue: A marker may genuinely be absent in Jurkat yet informative in PBMCs. Control-cell expression is not a universal assay-detectability criterion; validate appropriate positive material per target.

errors.quote: ADT: Centered log-ratio (CLR) transformation across cells, applied per sample to avoid batch effects.
errors.issue: Per-sample CLR does not guarantee removal of batch effects and can change biological composition contrasts. Specify transformation orientation, zero handling and technical background controls.

errors.quote: If technical covariates explain >80 % of the deviance
errors.issue: QC variables can reflect genuine activation, size or viability biology. Arbitrary deviance proportions do not identify technical causes, and correlated covariate sets do not uniquely partition causation.

Enrichment in the same RNA used to define cell states is not independent validation of a protein-regulatory mechanism. Required held-out donors/markers and orthogonal paired biological endpoints are absent from the main inference.

errors.quote: A flat profile across conditions supports Mechanism B.
errors.issue: Stable genuine biological discordance need not change during this stimulus/time range. Lack of a condition effect is not evidence of technical origin.

This is false for an independent two-proportion comparison of5% versus10% at two-sided0.05;75 cells is also the expected discordant numerator, not the denominator. More cells cannot replace donor-level power.

errors.quote: This fraction estimates the extent to which Mechanism A vs. B dominates.
errors.issue: Passing reproducibility/enrichment/time tests does not estimate a mixture fraction without a validated identifiable generative model. Orthogonal same-cell validation is deferred to future work, so the strong positive/negative state conclusions are not established.

rationale: Some concrete PBMC stimulation and computational choices, but the central pure-technical null, reproducibility statistic, variance partition and power justification are invalid. Scientific quality is low independently of the historical miss. No cell-specific adaptive integration or leakage-free biological benchmark is implemented.

Cell-specific learned modality utility and an explicit integrated neighborhood construction are essential for this historical target; generic calibrated weighting or a graph mention is insufficient.
Donor splitting must precede fitted transformations and tuning. Condition blinding does not replace independent endpoint validation or prevent marker-label circularity.

A technical-null mismatch need not define a new cell state. Low-count/QC correlation does not prove artifact. Use known-control calibration, independent phenotypes and quantitative sensitivity analyses.
